name: printingwatch
description: Namo Print — full-stack e-commerce (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-backend-env.js && node scripts/predev-all.js && npx --yes concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "node scripts/wait-for-backend.js && npm run dev:ui --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.deploy: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run seed --prefix backend
